description:
S&P 500 valuation verdict from a discounted-earnings (equity-risk-premium)
model: verdict (Very cheap / Cheap / Fair value / Rich / Very rich), the equity
risk premium the market currently implies (impliedErpPct, in percent — lower
means richer), the zone on the ladder, how far the market sits above (+) or below
(-) the Fair value band in percent, and five ERP bands each with its erpPct, its
fair value relative to the Fair value band, and the market's percent distance
from it. All values are percentages; index-point fair values, the index level and
the earnings inputs are intentionally not published. A model, not a forecast.
Self-caching (30 min). No parameters.
name: get_market_valuation
